note: Planned until a lawyer confirms client permission and data use. Guarded desktop forms only; dynamic forms and restricted portals unsupported. Use the client system manually.

steps: 1. Nothing to set up in Chausar yet: linking Client form browser is planned.

2. When it is built, Chausar will ask for written client permission and a revocable staff login entered by the owner, with read access to what it needs and write access only for what you approve, and no access to anything else.
3. Until then, use Client form browser on its own.
